title: Report the configured Codex stdin warning threshold and useful safe context
outcome: The non-aborting shared Codex stdin warning formats its actual configured warning threshold and identifies the affected command or session using safely bounded context, keeping warning timing, deduplication and timeout behavior unchanged.
acceptance: The warning reports SHARED_CODEX_STDIN_WARNING_AFTER rather than a separately hardcoded duration and includes useful command/session context without adding sensitive payload content.
Warning emission remains once per ordinary write or flush after the original threshold, outside the activity lock, and does not reset or shorten any deadline.
The existing thirty-second typed interrupt behavior and sixty-second ordinary deadline remain unchanged, and relevant verification/review evidence is recorded.
